summary.zh-CN: 修复工具完成后读不到结果、旧工具卡片被隐藏，以及压缩或裁剪后无法继续发消息的问题。
summary.en-US: Fix unreadable tool results, hidden populated tool cards, and conversations unable to continue after compaction or cropping.

title.zh-CN: 工具结果与会话连续性

body.zh-CN: 近期工具结果不再被历史预览提前替换。模型可在预算内读取文件内容、命令回显和校验值，有内容的旧工具卡片也可正常展开。
body.en-US: History previews no longer replace recent working results prematurely. Models can read file content, stdout and checksums within their budgets, and populated older tool cards remain visible.

body.zh-CN: 修复裁剪产生的空首轮及完整压缩后的旧坐标，兼容旧空首轮并从原始日志自动重建旧派生索引，不需要删除会话。原始正文和写盘失败保护保持；原 0.59.1 首因仍在调查。
body.en-US: Fix empty leading rounds and stale positions after full compaction, support older empty leading rounds, and rebuild older derived indexes from original journals. Original content and write-failure protection remain intact; the original 0.59.1 trigger is still under investigation.
